summary.text: Ed Jackson is a Republican state senator from Jackson who represents Tennessee Senate District 25 and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
A retired Tennant Company employee and small business owner, he chairs the Senate Government Operations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ed Jackson is married with three children, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
He attended Lambuth University, the Memphis State University School of Business and Ohio State University, and served in the Tennessee National Guard's 30th Armored Brigade.
His legislative biography lists him as retired from Tennant Company and a small business owner.
Jackson has been a member of the Senate from the 109th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He chairs the Senate Government Operations Committee and is a member of the Health and Welfare, State and Local Government and Rules committees.
He has served as vice president of marketing for the West Tennessee Area Council of the Boy Scouts of America and on the Jackson YMCA board.
